payload.title: Stage 0: live screen gate (pool, SME labels, agreement, Jev S vs F) -> STOP: owner looks
payload.description:
## Purpose

Stage 0 (live screen gate).

## Scope

Build the pool (3,000) and SME labels (1,500) via OpenAI; agreement check (second SME pass/model on 100 items, target >= 0.85); Jev S vs F on held-out 300. Report natural mix (random 300) and enriched mix; count of `abusive` (merge if < 20).

## Pass rule

F >= 0.80 macro-F1 and S <= F - 0.10. If F < 0.80, merge classes once and re-score; if no gap, stop.

## STOP

**Owner looks** before Stage 1.

## Definition of done

Text-free screen summary committed; one small table posted as a comment; owner's answer recorded.

## Caps

Own ledger with hard ceiling: ~600 Jev requests (S + F on held-out 300) + SME labeling/agreement calls; well under ~$3 of the epic's ~$10 total.
